up: Retrieve activity details for compound CHEMBL1422 (SITAGLIPTIN) and all its salts. Identify the set of related compounds by using the molecule_hierarchy table to find the parent molecule (where molregno = parent_molregno) and all child molecules (where parent_molregno = parent's molregno). For these compounds, return all rows where the standard_type is 'IC50' and standard_units is 'nM' against the target with chembl_id 'CHEMBL284' (Dipeptidyl peptidase 4). Return the following columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures), compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (preferring pubmed_id from docs, falling back to doi), assay_description (from assays), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment (from activities), target_chembl_id, target_name (from target_dictionary), and target_organism (from target_dictionary).
sql:
WITH compound_set AS (
  SELECT md.molregno, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id
  FROM molecule_dictionary md
  WHERE md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1422'
  UNION
  SELECT child.molregno, child.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
  JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1422'
)
SELECT
  cs.compound_chembl_id,
  mols.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.assay_description,
  act.standard_type,
  act.standard_relation,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units,
  act.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM compound_set cs
JOIN activities act ON cs.molregno = act.molregno
JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
LEFT JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id
LEFT JOIN compound_structures mols ON cs.molregno = mols.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM';
